C4 plants fix CO₂ into oxaloacetate in mesophyll cells, then transport it to bundle sheath cells for the Calvin cycle.  
CAM plants fix CO₂ into oxaloacetate at night (in mesophyll cells) and perform the Calvin cycle in the same cells during the day.  

Option (B) correctly describes this spatial separation in C4 plants and the lack of spatial separation in CAM plants.  

Final answer: (B)
